missing_index: An absent useful index can make a selective predicate use a broad access path and increase query work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: broad_filtered_scan is contextual.

order_by: Ordering or sorting work can require sort or temporary-work resources and is distinct from a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: ordering_clause is direct.

query_whole_table: A broad full-table read or scan increases read and execution work but is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: unrestricted_relation_read is direct.

record_lock: Conflicting record updates or transactions create lock contention. It can coexist with an independent read or query-work mechanism. Metric roles: lock-wait is direct evidence, expected direction elevated; lock-occupancy is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated; execution-pressure is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: row_lock_wait is direct; row_locking_clause is contextual.

query_whole_table: A broad full-table read or scan increases read and execution work but is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: unrestricted_relation_read is direct.

missing_index: An absent useful index can make a selective predicate use a broad access path and increase query work; it is not a lock primitive. query_whole_table: A broad full-table read or scan increases read and execution work but is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: unrestricted_relation_read is direct.

Semantic query-shape roles: row_lock_wait is direct; row_locking_clause is contextual.

query_with_too_much_join: An overly large multi-table join can increase cardinality and join work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: multi_table_join is direct.

query_whole_table: A broad full-table read or scan increases read and execution work but is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: unrestricted_relation_read is direct.

order_by: Ordering or sorting work can require sort or temporary-work resources and is distinct from a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: ordering_clause is direct.

implicit_conversion: A runtime type conversion in a predicate or join can make a selective condition non-sargable and increase access work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: predicate_type_conversion is direct.

mechanism_cards.summary: implicit_conversion: A runtime type conversion in a predicate or join can make a selective condition non-sargable and increase access work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: predicate_type_conversion is direct.

missing_index: An absent useful index can make a selective predicate use a broad access path and increase query work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: broad_filtered_scan is contextual.

order_by: Ordering or sorting work can require sort or temporary-work resources and is distinct from a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: ordering_clause is direct.

query_with_too_much_join: An overly large multi-table join can increase cardinality and join work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: multi_table_join is direct.

record_lock: Conflicting record updates or transactions create lock contention. It can coexist with an independent read or query-work mechanism. Metric roles: lock-wait is direct evidence, expected direction elevated; lock-occupancy is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated; execution-pressure is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: row_lock_wait is direct; row_locking_clause is contextual.

mechanism_cards.summary: group_by: SQL grouping or aggregation work can require aggregation or temporary-work resources and is distinct from a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: aggregation_clause is direct.

implicit_conversion: A runtime type conversion in a predicate or join can make a selective condition non-sargable and increase access work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: predicate_type_conversion is direct.

order_by: Ordering or sorting work can require sort or temporary-work resources and is distinct from a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: ordering_clause is direct.

query_with_too_much_join: An overly large multi-table join can increase cardinality and join work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: multi_table_join is direct.

record_lock: Conflicting record updates or transactions create lock contention. It can coexist with an independent read or query-work mechanism. Metric roles: lock-wait is direct evidence, expected direction elevated; lock-occupancy is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated; execution-pressure is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: row_lock_wait is direct; row_locking_clause is contextual.

order_by: Ordering or sorting work can require sort or temporary-work resources and is distinct from a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: ordering_clause is direct.

query_with_too_much_join: An overly large multi-table join can increase cardinality and join work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: multi_table_join is direct.

record_lock: Conflicting record updates or transactions create lock contention. It can coexist with an independent read or query-work mechanism. Metric roles: lock-wait is direct evidence, expected direction elevated; lock-occupancy is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated; execution-pressure is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: row_lock_wait is direct; row_locking_clause is contextual.

order_by: Ordering or sorting work can require sort or temporary-work resources and is distinct from a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: ordering_clause is direct.

missing_index: An absent useful index can make a selective predicate use a broad access path and increase query work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: broad_filtered_scan is contextual.

group_by: SQL grouping or aggregation work can require aggregation or temporary-work resources and is distinct from a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: aggregation_clause is direct.

mechanism_cards.summary: group_by: SQL grouping or aggregation work can require aggregation or temporary-work resources and is distinct from a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: aggregation_clause is direct.

implicit_conversion: A runtime type conversion in a predicate or join can make a selective condition non-sargable and increase access work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: predicate_type_conversion is direct.

order_by: Ordering or sorting work can require sort or temporary-work resources and is distinct from a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: ordering_clause is direct.

query_whole_table: A broad full-table read or scan increases read and execution work but is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: unrestricted_relation_read is direct.

record_lock: Conflicting record updates or transactions create lock contention. It can coexist with an independent read or query-work mechanism. Metric roles: lock-wait is direct evidence, expected direction elevated; lock-occupancy is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated; execution-pressure is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: row_lock_wait is direct; row_locking_clause is contextual.

mechanism_cards.summary: missing_index: An absent useful index can make a selective predicate use a broad access path and increase query work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: broad_filtered_scan is contextual.

order_by: Ordering or sorting work can require sort or temporary-work resources and is distinct from a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: ordering_clause is direct.

query_whole_table: A broad full-table read or scan increases read and execution work but is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: unrestricted_relation_read is direct.

query_with_too_much_join: An overly large multi-table join can increase cardinality and join work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: multi_table_join is direct.

record_lock: Conflicting record updates or transactions create lock contention. It can coexist with an independent read or query-work mechanism. Metric roles: lock-wait is direct evidence, expected direction elevated; lock-occupancy is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated; execution-pressure is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: row_lock_wait is direct; row_locking_clause is contextual.

mechanism_cards.summary: missing_index: An absent useful index can make a selective predicate use a broad access path and increase query work; it is not a lock primitive. order_by: Ordering or sorting work can require sort or temporary-work resources and is distinct from a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: ordering_clause is direct.

query_whole_table: A broad full-table read or scan increases read and execution work but is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: unrestricted_relation_read is direct.

query_with_too_much_join: An overly large multi-table join can increase cardinality and join work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: multi_table_join is direct.

record_lock: Conflicting record updates or transactions create lock contention. It can coexist with an independent read or query-work mechanism. Metric roles: lock-wait is direct evidence, expected direction elevated; lock-occupancy is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated; execution-pressure is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: row_lock_wait is direct; row_locking_clause is contextual.

implicit_conversion: A runtime type conversion in a predicate or join can make a selective condition non-sargable and increase access work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: predicate_type_conversion is direct.

order_by: Ordering or sorting work can require sort or temporary-work resources and is distinct from a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: ordering_clause is direct.

query_whole_table: A broad full-table read or scan increases read and execution work but is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: unrestricted_relation_read is direct.

record_lock: Conflicting record updates or transactions create lock contention. It can coexist with an independent read or query-work mechanism. Metric roles: lock-wait is direct evidence, expected direction elevated; lock-occupancy is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated; execution-pressure is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: row_lock_wait is direct; row_locking_clause is contextual.

missing_index: An absent useful index can make a selective predicate use a broad access path and increase query work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: broad_filtered_scan is contextual.

order_by: Ordering or sorting work can require sort or temporary-work resources and is distinct from a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: ordering_clause is direct.

query_whole_table: A broad full-table read or scan increases read and execution work but is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: unrestricted_relation_read is direct.

record_lock: Conflicting record updates or transactions create lock contention. It can coexist with an independent read or query-work mechanism. Metric roles: lock-wait is direct evidence, expected direction elevated; lock-occupancy is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated; execution-pressure is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: row_lock_wait is direct; row_locking_clause is contextual.

mechanism_cards.summary: group_by: SQL grouping or aggregation work can require aggregation or temporary-work resources and is distinct from a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: aggregation_clause is direct.

implicit_conversion: A runtime type conversion in a predicate or join can make a selective condition non-sargable and increase access work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: predicate_type_conversion is direct.

order_by: Ordering or sorting work can require sort or temporary-work resources and is distinct from a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: ordering_clause is direct.

query_whole_table: A broad full-table read or scan increases read and execution work but is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: unrestricted_relation_read is direct.

record_lock: Conflicting record updates or transactions create lock contention. It can coexist with an independent read or query-work mechanism. Metric roles: lock-wait is direct evidence, expected direction elevated; lock-occupancy is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated; execution-pressure is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: row_lock_wait is direct; row_locking_clause is contextual.

mechanism_cards.summary: record_lock: Conflicting record updates or transactions create lock contention. It can coexist with an independent read or query-work mechanism. Metric roles: lock-wait is direct evidence, expected direction elevated; lock-occupancy is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated; execution-pressure is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: row_lock_wait is direct; row_locking_clause is contextual.

query_whole_table: A broad full-table read or scan increases read and execution work but is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: unrestricted_relation_read is direct.

missing_index: An absent useful index can make a selective predicate use a broad access path and increase query work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: broad_filtered_scan is contextual.

implicit_conversion: A runtime type conversion in a predicate or join can make a selective condition non-sargable and increase access work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: predicate_type_conversion is direct.

group_by: SQL grouping or aggregation work can require aggregation or temporary-work resources and is distinct from a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: aggregation_clause is direct.

mechanism_cards.summary: group_by: SQL grouping or aggregation work can require aggregation or temporary-work resources and is distinct from a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: aggregation_clause is direct.

implicit_conversion: A runtime type conversion in a predicate or join can make a selective condition non-sargable and increase access work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: predicate_type_conversion is direct.

missing_index: An absent useful index can make a selective predicate use a broad access path and increase query work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: broad_filtered_scan is contextual.

order_by: Ordering or sorting work can require sort or temporary-work resources and is distinct from a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: ordering_clause is direct.

record_lock: Conflicting record updates or transactions create lock contention. It can coexist with an independent read or query-work mechanism. Metric roles: lock-wait is direct evidence, expected direction elevated; lock-occupancy is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated; execution-pressure is contextual evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: row_lock_wait is direct; row_locking_clause is contextual.

missing_index: An absent useful index can make a selective predicate use a broad access path and increase query work; it is not a lock primitive. query_whole_table: A broad full-table read or scan increases read and execution work but is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: unrestricted_relation_read is direct.

query_whole_table: A broad full-table read or scan increases read and execution work but is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: unrestricted_relation_read is direct.

missing_index: An absent useful index can make a selective predicate use a broad access path and increase query work; it is not a lock primitive. group_by: SQL grouping or aggregation work can require aggregation or temporary-work resources and is distinct from a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: aggregation_clause is direct.
